review_role: independent second visual review after generation-agent validation
method: Read all 124 final PNG files from manifest paths; inspect eight in-memory contact sheets with alternating light and dark backgrounds at approximately 210 px per icon. Enlarge nine-tooth rake and both Eight Immortals icons to approximately 398 px to confirm counts. Recompute each file SHA and inspect RGBA data for strongly saturated residual magenta.
conclusions: All 124 icons have a consistent rounded Daoist Q art style with jade, warm ivory and gold materials.
No obvious neighboring-cell fragments, duplicated border pieces or clipped object silhouettes were visible in the inspected sheets.
Named item categories match the visible objects at icon presentation scale; no obvious wrong-item substitution found.
The nine-tooth rake has nine visible teeth. Both Eight Immortals icons contain eight visible figures.
All final canvases remain 600 x 600 RGBA and match their manifest hashes. No visible strongly saturated residual magenta pixels were detected by R > 200, G < 100, B > 200, A > 0.
limitations: This is a final icon-art and extraction review, not a client integration or historical iconography certification. Existing technical atlas validation remains in validation.json.
